units.summary: New test helper that builds a DB populated with N series of in-order samples for benchmarks. It is only used by test code, so it has no effect on production.
units.headline: Add benchmark helper building head with N series
units.reason: New test-only helper; cannot affect production.

units.summary: New benchmark of CompactSelectedSeries at several selection fractions, rebuilding the DB on every iteration. It is test-only.
units.headline: Add benchmark for CompactSelectedSeries across selection fractions

units.summary: New public DB method. It filters out series that have out-of-order data, writes blocks for the selected series through the shared compactHeadViewLocked, then evicts those series from the head without advancing HeadMinTime. It records metrics and returns early when the input is empty or every series is filtered out.
units.headline: Add CompactSelectedSeries to persist and evict chosen head series
units.reason: New public API that persists blocks and evicts series from the head.
focus: Isolation-disabled mode: a sample appended late can be lost on eviction
Concurrent appends between filtering and eviction
The failed-compactions metric must also count errors from the filtering step

units.summary: New happy-path test for CompactSelectedSeries. It checks eviction, the block hint, that HeadMinTime does not change, and the metrics. It is test-only.
units.headline: Test happy path of CompactSelectedSeries

units.summary: New test checking that nil or empty input is a no-op that writes no block and does not bump the triggered counter. It is test-only.
units.headline: Test empty ref list is a no-op

units.summary: New test checking that a series spanning two chunk ranges produces two blocks, each carrying the selected-series hint. It is test-only.
units.headline: Test one block per chunk range for spanning series
